title: Use Alexa+ as a meeting timer and Pomodoro helper during work breaks
facebook: Struggling to take real breaks during a busy day? Here's a simple trick: ask your smart speaker to set a 25-minute focus block, then a 5-minute break — it'll speak up when each one ends. Your brain will thank you. https://aiworldhq.com/article/use-alexa-as-a-meeting-timer-and-pomodoro-helper-on-work-breaks #productivity #worktips
